selection_rule: Advance the sole compound tensor field to one separately frozen spent raw-topology audit only if every parent, coefficient-reproduction, convergence, boundary, positivity, nonperturbative-response, stability, zero-slip, parameter-accounting, and no-score gate passes.
claim_boundary: The 5% nonperturbative-response gate is frozen before this field is solved and is not a raw-lens accuracy threshold.

The compound rule remains a constitutive hypothesis without a covariant action or microscopic derivation.
P0633 galaxy kinematics and P0640 cluster lens constraints remain sealed.
